issue_title: [Bug] __post_init__ allows empty text when Todo is constructed directly
summary: Add text validation in Todo.__post_init__ to reject empty or whitespace-only text, ensuring consistency with rename() method behavior.
approach: TDD with minimal fix - added 4 regression tests first, then implemented validation in __post_init__ that strips whitespace and raises ValueError for empty text.
risks: Breaking change: Direct construction with empty/whitespace text will now raise ValueError (intended fix)
Existing code paths through TodoApp.add() already validate, so only direct construction is affected
